record.source_closeout_reference: Rung-2 preparation mission RUNG2_PREP_20260611; envelope and sponsor-decision record under docs/Factory/v3/ladder/rung2/; committed with the mission changes per the same_commit convention

mission.objective: Record sponsor decision HDI-RUNG2-001 (rung-2 transport = Codex harness with Codex mobile, option b from the LADDER_STATUS.md gate-1 options) as a structured decision record, and bring the ladder status, anchor registry, and transport trial plan into consistency with it.

forbidden_scope: no transport use in this mission
no validator, fixture, template, or skill changes
no new approval or promotion language beyond recording the named sponsor decision
no files outside the envelope list
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push at closeout

verification.summary: Advisory suite run at closeout after all authorized-file edits; results recorded below.

notes: Docs-only recording mission with no new dependencies, no transport use, and no executable change.
The decision record approves the transport selection only; rung 2 itself still requires its own envelope and explicit sponsor Go, stated in every touched file.

The transport decision was taken by the sponsor in-thread via a structured option prompt before the envelope was written; the envelope records this as a Tier 1 pre-resolved input rather than re-opening it.
No halt or fallback trigger fired; all edits stayed inside the six authorized files.

friction_notes: The gate-1 decision was raised at end-of-day 2026-06-10 inside LADDER_STATUS.md rather than as a standing structured interrupt record, so this mission had to construct the HDI record one day after the question was named; raising future cross-session sponsor decisions as structured records at raise time would remove that backfill step.

LADDER_STATUS.md v0.2 carried a duplicate-numbering defect in its remaining-gates list (two gates numbered 2), introduced under end-of-day pressure and fixed here; pickup aids written at day end may deserve a one-pass reread before commit.
false_positive_notes: None observed in this mission's advisory pass.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: Transport availability proved to be org-policy-gated runtime state exactly as MUTABLE_HARNESS_STATE.md frames harness capability: the rung-2 envelope must record the transport's observed working state at mission start, not assume the plan-time selection still holds.

Recording a sponsor decision taken in-thread at session start (before any envelope existed) fit cleanly into the envelope-first discipline by classifying it as a Tier 1 pre-resolved input to the recording mission.

The session surfaced a sponsor design question about waypoints as first-class record objects (typed waypoints with id, scope, budget slice, verification, continuation rule); current canon treats waypoints as envelope prose with checkpoints as the recorded structure, and the rung-2 envelope is the natural place to trial a structured waypoint table before any schema proposal.
